structured_output.what_is_happening: Cream Inu (CREAMINU) is a pump.fun bonding-curve coin, 23 minutes old, with an $18k market cap. It uses the adult-content creator Bonnie Blue as a meme: its X link is her account (@BonnieBlue_xoxo), and the description says trading fees go to her through UsePaid. That is a common fee-share launch template, and nothing shows she endorsed it. Price rose about 360% in the first 30 minutes on $46k of volume. It is now about 20% below its all-time high, and over the last 5 minutes sells (35) outnumber buys (28). GMGN flags 77 bundler wallets and a 4-wallet insider transfer network. GMGN also says 100 tokens have been launched tied to that X handle, so her name is used over and over for coins.

narrative.description: A crude joke on Bonnie Blue, who is well known, plus the fact that she apparently sells ice cream now (there are TikTok posts about it). Fees are routed to her account via UsePaid, which gives a thin 'celebrity might claim the fees' angle.
narrative.why_spreading: I found no fresh news or event. Buying looks driven by pump.fun launch mechanics and bundles, not by an outside trigger. Bonnie Blue coins are launched constantly (GMGN counts 100 tokens tied to her X account).

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the earlier and larger of the two CREAMINU tickers and the only one using the Bonnie Blue angle. But nothing ties Bonnie Blue herself to this coin; she is one of about 100 coins using her handle.
token_connection.competing_tokens: GL6cK7oXNPTVSHCmjji9rQeJCkquRTSBe8JVXJ9XGgec 'ICE CREAM DOG' has the same ticker, a $3.4k market cap and was created later. It is not a real competitor. The more important competition is the many other Bonnie Blue coins, such as BLUEB.

authenticity.evidence: 77 bundler wallets and a 23% top-bundler share, a bot/degen rate of 0.50, a 4-wallet insider transfer network, and the page is marked as a community takeover (CTO). On the other side: 292 unique buyers and 211 unique sellers, no paid DexScreener boosts, and 3 smart wallets.
authenticity.uncertainty: I have no X post data. Searches for the contract address returned nothing relevant.

structural_risks: 77 bundler wallets could dump into the bonding curve
The creator has closed their position; GMGN says the dev launched 2 tokens, with a best all-time high of only $23k
Sells now outnumber buys and price is about 20% below the all-time high, so the first pump looks spent
The curve is still about 45 virtual SOL short of migrating

structured_output.counterargument: At $18k the market cap is tiny. Doubling only needs about $37k, still on the curve. Around 290 unique buyers in 30 minutes is real turnover. If Bonnie Blue or fans notice the fee-share, or the coin heads toward graduating the curve, a second leg is plausible. Mint and freeze are renounced and the creator holds nothing.
unknowns: Whether Bonnie Blue knows about the fee-share or has posted anything
Whether the bundler wallets still hold supply

source_coverage.notes: Contract-address search returned nothing relevant. The Bonnie Blue search found only general ice-cream TikTok posts and a different token (BLUEB). The usepaid.app page failed with an SSL error. Time limit was tight.

structured_output.thesis: A low-effort Bonnie Blue fee-share meme, one of many using her name, with heavy bundling. The first 360% pump is done and momentum is cooling. The tiny market cap still allows a second leg, but I found no outside catalyst. Below-average chance of a runner.
